remarks:
Zoned C-2 General Commercial, this property offers flexibility for a wide variety of
potential uses. Permitted uses may include retail sales, restaurants, offices, personal-
service businesses, new or used motor vehicle sales and service, boat or marine sales
and service, custom trade shops, warehouses, wholesale sales and distribution,
building-material supply, contractor equipment and material storage, machine and tool
sales, rentals and service, and other commercial ventures. With frontage on both
Milestrip and Route 62, its location provides convenient access to surrounding
communities and may offer excellent visibility for a future business. Whether you are an
investor, developer, contractor, or business owner looking for room to establish or
expand an operation, this property presents an exciting opportunity to bring your plans
to life. Development of a new commercial use requires site-plan approval from the Town
of North Collins and must comply with applicable access, parking, setback, utility,
environmental, and building requirements. Availability and location of utilities, permitted
uses, driveway approval, acreage, frontage, and development feasibility should be
independently verified by the purchaser with the appropriate municipal and
governmental agencies. Bring your vision and explore the possibilities this C-2 General
Commercial property has to offer!
